# `/violations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /violations/v1

`listViolationsV1` — List Policy Violations

Returns a paged list of policy violations for the current tenant. Requires the read scope (idn:sod-violation:read). This endpoint uses the standard collection parameters defined in [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters/). This endpoint supports standard V3 collection parameters: `limit`, `offset`, `count`, `filters`, and `sorters`. Embedded references in each violation (`owner`, `target`, `policy`, and references inside…

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: status: eq, in; policyId: eq; ownerId: eq; level: eq, in; policyName: eq, in, sw, co; ownerName: eq, in, sw, co; targetName: eq, in, sw, co; targetId: eq, in — e.g. `status in ("Open","Mitigated") and level eq "High" and policyId eq "bc693f07-e7b6-4553-9626-c25954c58554" and ownerId eq "de305d54-75b4-431b-adb2-eb6b9e546014"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: level Prefix a field with - for descending order, for example -level. If no sorters are provided, results default to created descending, then id descending. — e.g. `-level`
- Returns 200: array of policyviolationresponse

### GET /violations/v1/{id}

`getViolationV1` — Get policy violation by ID

Returns a single policy violation by ID for the current tenant. Access is allowed if the caller has the read scope (`idn:sod-violation:read`) or is an owner of the violation (direct or via governance group). Returns 403 Forbidden if the violation exists but the caller has neither the read scope nor ownership. Returns 404 Not Found if the violation does not exist for the tenant. Embedded references (`owner`, `target`, `policy`, and references inside `appliedControls`) use `ReferenceResponse`:…

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:read
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the policy violation to fetch
- Returns 200: policyviolationresponse

### POST /violations/v1/{id}/controls

`startApplyControlV1` — Apply control to violation

Applies a compensating control to the specified policy violation. Callers without the `idn:sod-violation:manage` scope may only apply a control to violations they own (directly, or via a governance group they belong to).

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the policy violation to fetch
- Body (application/json): appliedcontrolcreate
- Returns 201: appliedcontrol

### POST /violations/v1/{id}/reassign

`moveViolationV1` — Reassign policy violation

Reassigns the specified policy violation to a new owner. Callers without the `idn:sod-violation:manage` scope may only reassign violations they own (directly, or via a governance group they belong to).

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage
- User levels: Any
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the policy violation to fetch
- Body (application/json): violationreassigninput
- Returns 200: policyviolationresponse
